We propose a phased plan that delivers State Life’s content-managed corporate website and integrated customer self-service portal with secure authentication/RBAC, REST API integration to the core policy system, and a tested payment gateway, followed by one-year warranty support with defined response times aligned to our in-country support desk model (24–48h SLAs) [CO-PROFILE]. Our schedule is sized to be realistic for an enterprise, security-sensitive rollout, drawing on durations we have executed on comparable, integration-heavy programs such as Mobile Banking (13–23 months) [CAP-047][CAP-011] and LMS/ERP implementations (15–25 months) [CAP-026][CAP-046], while compressing delivery through an MVP-first release and parallel workstreams.

Planned timeline (target 24 weeks from Notice to Proceed, then 52 weeks support):
1) Mobilization & discovery (Weeks 1–3): requirements elaboration, content inventory, UX research, API/payment gateway technical workshops, and project controls under ISO 9001 quality management [CO-PROFILE].
2) UX/UI & solution design (Weeks 4–7): responsive, accessible front-end designs and portal user journeys; security-by-design controls aligned to our ISO 27001 certification [CO-PROFILE].
3) Build sprint(s) for CMS website + portal MVP (Weeks 8–16): policy view, document download, service requests, and payment initiation; audit trail and role-based access.
4) Integrations & hardening (Weeks 12–18, parallel): REST API integration and payment gateway integration; environment setup for deployment to State Life’s cloud (we have delivered federal cloud infrastructure programs) [CAP-012].
5) System/Performance/UAT & go-live (Weeks 19–24): end-to-end testing, security testing, data/content migration, training and handover.

Warranty support (Months 7–18): incident management, patches, minor enhancements, and quarterly preventive maintenance as agreed [CO-PROFILE].
